claims.locator: IMS header, former conformed name Burroughs Corp
claims.sourceText: Unisys Corporation Form 10-K filed 29 March 1994, CIK 0000746838, with SEC IMS header
claims.text: SEC's own IMS header on the Unisys Form 10-K records 'FORMER CONFORMED NAME: BURROUGHS CORP /DE/ ... DATE OF NAME CHANGE: 19861204'. The same filing shows Unisys carrying the Sperry Corporation Pension Plan for Outside Directors by incorporation from Sperry Corporation's own Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended 31 March 1984 (File No. 1-3908), and discusses 'its sale of the Sperry Aerospace Group in December 1986'.
